name: U-Ming Marine Transport Corp
summary: U-Ming Marine Transport Corporation, operating globally with its affiliated entities, specializes in maritime transport services. The company possesses and oversees a substantial fleet of vessels responsible for conveying various bulk commodities, such as cement, petroleum, iron ore, coal, and different grain products. Currently, their active fleet totals 66 ships, boasting a combined deadweight tonnage of 8.25 million. Established in 1968 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, the company was formerly recognized as Yue Ming Transportation Co. U-Ming Marine Transport Corporation functions as a subsidiary of The Far Eastern Group.
